textos.Um retrato do setor elétrico de Minas a: A portrait of the Minas Gerais electricity sector based on public data sources
textos.Os dados sobre geração, capacidade insta: Data on generation, installed capacity and electricity consumption in Minas Gerais existed, but were spread across different databases, with different concepts, units and reference periods. Without consolidating them at the state level, it was difficult to assess plans and policies and to gauge the state's role in the national electricity system, of which Minas Gerais accounted for 9.8% of generation in 2024.
textos.O retrato seguiu a lógica do Balanço Ene: The portrait followed the logic of Brazil's National Energy Balance (BEN), adapted to the state level. Regional data were collected from official databases, systematized and consolidated into historical series, structuring the electricity mix, installed capacity and consumption by consumer class, with breakdowns by source and by sector. The socioeconomic dimension, which relates consumption, economic activity and GDP, was brought in through indicators such as electricity intensity.
textos.Relatório, base de dados e painel digita: A report, a database and a digital dashboard, all publicly available. The Overview consolidates the electricity mix of Minas Gerais and the evolution of electricity generation and consumption, and connects with other studies by the Directorate, such as the one on energy efficiency in industry.

textos.Onde a indústria mineira tem mais a ganh: Where industry in Minas Gerais has the most to gain from efficiency
textos.A indústria responde por 52,39% do consu: Industry accounts for 52.39% of electricity consumption in Minas Gerais, compared with 35.19% in Brazil, and this demand is concentrated: metallurgy and mining account for 58.9% of the state's industrial electricity consumption. What remained was to identify where energy efficiency has the greatest potential and which policy instruments can support it.
textos.A análise examinou a evolução do consumo: The analysis examined the evolution of industrial consumption by segment and the electricity intensity of industry. Because electricity intensity alone does not measure technical efficiency, it was read together with the sectoral composition and the weight of electro-intensive segments. From this, priority segments and activities were identified, and technologies, management practices and policy instruments were surveyed, relating efficiency, industrial competitiveness and reductions in consumption and emissions.
textos.Estudo com recomendações para o planejam: A study with recommendations for state planning, accompanied by outreach materials and consultation tools. It continues the series begun with the Guide for Municipalities on Energy Efficiency in Public Buildings.
textos.do consumo elétrico industrial de Minas: of industrial electricity consumption in Minas Gerais is concentrated in metallurgy and mining (2024)
textos.Do conjunto de estudos à agenda: o Progr: From a set of studies to an agenda: the Low-Emission Technologies Program
textos.A Diretoria de Energia tinha estudos, ba: The Energy Directorate had studies, databases, guides, regulatory frameworks and initiatives produced at different times and without a common framework. This made it hard to show the coherence of the work, set priorities and connect the energy agenda to the state's economic development goals.
textos.O programa foi estruturado em quatro eta: The program was structured in four stages: identifying the available studies and materials, surveying the regulatory instruments and related policies, grouping the content into strategic pillars and organizing the deliverables. The pillars are Energy Intelligence and Planning, Energy Efficiency, Low-Emission Technologies and Fuels, and Economic Development and Investment Attraction.
textos.O programa foi concebido para ir além de: The program was designed to go beyond an inventory. By placing planning, efficiency, low-emission technologies and investment attraction within the same framework, it links energy policy to the state's economic development agenda and allows each study to be read as part of a whole. This organization also makes the gaps between the pillars visible, which helps decide which studies and instruments should come next.

textos.A transição energética na Amazônia Legal: The energy transition in the Legal Amazon, seen through its territories and people
textos.Como se distribuem impactos, riscos e op: How are the impacts, risks and opportunities of the energy transition distributed among the territories, peoples and communities of the Legal Amazon?
textos.A metodologia combinou Teoria da Mudança: The methodology combined Theory of Change and analytical matrices applied to five themes: bioeconomy, access to energy, socio-environmental inequalities, traditional peoples and communities, and climate governance. The evidence base brought together technical documents, scientific literature, public data and institutional reports.

It compared vulnerabilities, local capacities and pathways for diversification and productive reconversion.
